title: TPMS Event Information / Sensor Missing
meaning: Mazda BCM/TPMS module failed to receive RF radio packet from one or more direct wheel tire pressure sensors within timeout.
symptoms: TPMS light solid or flashing for 1 minute on startup
inspectionSteps: Check tire pressures on all four wheels with manual gauge.
Check if aftermarket wheels without TPMS sensors are mounted.
Use 315MHz/433MHz TPMS tool to check wheel sensor battery life.
verifiedFixes: Perform Mazda TPMS relearn procedure (drive >15 mph for 10 mins)
Replace dead internal coin battery in tire sensor / replace sensor

title: Steering Wheel Position Sensor Plausibility
meaning: ABS/DSC module detected variance between steering angle sensor rate-of-turn and lateral accelerometer during G-Vectoring Control (GVC) calculation.
symptoms: TCS / DSC warning light illuminated
G-Vectoring Control disabled message
inspectionSteps: Verify wheel alignment (center steering wheel on straight road).
Check front wheel speed sensor wiring and tire circumference consistency.
Perform steering angle zero-point calibration.
verifiedFixes: Perform wheel alignment and steering angle sensor center-calibration
Clean front wheel speed sensor reluctor teeth

title: Engine Coolant Temperature Sensor 1/2 Correlation
meaning: PCM detected temperature discrepancy between Engine Coolant Temp (ECT) sensor 1 (cylinder head) and sensor 2 (radiator outlet) on Skyactiv-G 2.0L / 2.5L engines (Mazda 3, CX-5, Mazda 6, MX-5 ND).
symptoms: Check Engine light illuminated
Heater blows lukewarm air during winter driving
Engine slow to enter closed-loop fuel control
Radiator cooling fan running continuously
inspectionSteps: Compare ECT1 and ECT2 live data temperature readings during engine warm-up on scan tool.
Inspect coolant control valve (electric thermostat multi-way valve) for sticking in semi-open position.
Check for air pockets in heater core; bleed cooling system using funnel adapter.
Review Mazda Technical Service Bulletin TSB 01-009/19.
verifiedFixes: Replace electric coolant control valve assembly with updated Mazda revision part (TSB 01-009/19).
Perform vacuum refill of cooling system with genuine Mazda FL22 Long Life coolant.

title: Warm Up Catalyst Efficiency Below Threshold (Bank 1)
meaning: PCM catalytic converter efficiency monitor detected Bank 1 converter oxygen storage capacity is below threshold on Mazda 2.0L/2.5L Skyactiv.
symptoms: Check Engine light illuminated
No perceptible change in driveability or performance
inspectionSteps: Inspect 4-2-1 factory tuned exhaust manifold (header) and donut gasket for pinhole exhaust leaks upstream of secondary O2 sensor drawing in false ambient air.
Check for Mazda PCM calibration software update per TSB 01-010/18 (overly sensitive catalyst deterioration monitoring logic).
Log upstream A/F sensor and downstream O2 sensor voltages on highway cruise; downstream should hold flat 0.6-0.8V.
verifiedFixes: Reprogram PCM with updated Mazda calibration file per TSB 01-010/18 before replacing catalytic converter.
Replace leaking exhaust manifold flange gasket / donut seal.
Replace Bank 1 catalytic converter exhaust manifold assembly if converter honeycomb substrate is degraded.

title: Active Grille Air Shutter 'A' Stuck
meaning: The PCM commanded the active aerodynamic grille shutter (AGS) actuator to open or close, but mechanical position feedback indicated an obstructed or jammed vane.
symptoms: Check Engine Light on
Slight increase in highway coolant temp or aerodynamic drag
inspectionSteps: Inspect lower front bumper grille louvers for road debris, ice, or pebbles wedging the blades.
Unplug AGS actuator harness and check for moisture or bent pins.
Gently cycle shutter blades by hand with ignition off to check for mechanical binding.
verifiedFixes: Dislodge road debris/pebbles jamming grille shutter blades
Replace Active Grille Air Shutter actuator assembly
